bio: ML Lead @BayanSpeechAI. Building low-latency duplex speech-to-speech models for Tagalog, Cebuano, and Taglish customer operations.
discovered_via: SEG-04: Regional AI & Robotics Lab Researchers

recent_posts.text: Standard byte-level BPE tokenizers inflate Tagalog-English code-switched transcripts by 1.9x tokens compared to English, killing TTFT in voice agents. Our morphology-aware subword vocabulary reduced token fertility to 1.18x and cut end-to-end voice turn latency by 280ms.
